title: Identify the PostgreSQL server
overview: Establish the exact server build before reasoning about features or catalog columns.
syntaxBreakdown: version() returns the server build string.
sqlText: SELECT version();
expectedResult: Rows describing identify the postgresql server.
systemsLens: Establish node and session context before comparing systems.

title: Inspect session identity
overview: See which database, role, client, address, and backend process this session uses.
syntaxBreakdown: current_* values describe identity; inet_* and pg_backend_pid() describe the connection.
sqlText: SELECT current_database() AS database, current_user AS role, session_user, inet_client_addr() AS client_addr, inet_server_addr() AS server_addr, pg_backend_pid() AS pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect session identity.
systemsLens: Establish node and session context before comparing systems.

title: Measure server uptime
overview: Find when this instance started and how long the current postmaster has been alive.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_postmaster_start_time() returns startup time; clock_timestamp() supplies current wall time.
sqlText: SELECT pg_postmaster_start_time() AS started_at, clock_timestamp() - pg_postmaster_start_time() AS uptime;
expectedResult: Rows describing measure server uptime.
systemsLens: Establish node and session context before comparing systems.

title: Inventory databases
overview: Compare database ownership, connection policy, encoding, locale, and size.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_database holds database metadata; pg_database_size(oid) measures disk use.
sqlText: SELECT datname, pg_get_userbyid(datdba) AS owner, datallowconn, datconnlimit, pg_encoding_to_char(encoding) AS encoding, datcollate, datctype, pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(oid)) AS size FROM pg_database ORDER BY datname;
expectedResult: Rows describing inventory databases.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inventory schemas
overview: Understand namespaces and who owns them.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_namespace stores schemas; pg_get_userbyid resolves owner OIDs.
sqlText: SELECT nspname AS schema, pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner FROM pg_namespace ORDER BY nspname;
expectedResult: Rows describing inventory schemas.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inventory relation types
overview: See tables, indexes, sequences, views, partitions, and foreign tables by schema.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_class describes relations; relkind encodes type; pg_namespace supplies schema.
sqlText: SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname, c.relkind, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_toast' ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inventory relation types.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Decode relation kinds
overview: Translate pg_class relkind codes into useful object categories.
syntaxBreakdown: CASE maps catalog codes; count(*) summarizes each kind.
sqlText: SELECT relkind, CASE relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' WHEN 'i' THEN 'index' WHEN 'S' THEN 'sequence' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view' WHEN 'm' THEN 'materialized view' WHEN 'f' THEN 'foreign table' WHEN 'p' THEN 'partitioned table' WHEN 'I' THEN 'partitioned index' ELSE 'other' END AS kind, count(*) FROM pg_class GROUP BY relkind ORDER BY relkind;
expectedResult: Rows describing decode relation kinds.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect table columns through catalogs
overview: Learn how PostgreSQL represents columns, types, nullability, identity, and generated attributes.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_attribute stores columns; format_type renders type OIDs and modifiers.
sqlText: SELECT attnum,attname,format_type(atttypid,atttypmod) AS type,attnotnull,attidentity,attgenerated FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped ORDER BY attnum;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect table columns through catalogs.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Understand OIDs and regclass
overview: Resolve human-readable relation names to object identifiers and back.
syntaxBreakdown: ::regclass resolves a name; ::oid exposes its numeric OID.
sqlText: SELECT 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass AS regclass_name, 'pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass::oid AS object_id, ('pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass::oid)::regclass AS resolved_back;
expectedResult: Rows describing understand oids and regclass.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect constraints
overview: See primary, foreign, unique, check, and exclusion constraints as catalog objects.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_constraint stores type; pg_get_constraintdef reconstructs SQL.
sqlText: SELECT conrelid::regclass AS relation,conname,contype,convalidated,pg_get_constraintdef(oid,true) AS definition FROM pg_constraint ORDER BY conrelid::regclass::text,conname LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect constraints.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect index definitions
overview: Connect indexes to tables and see uniqueness, validity, readiness, and DDL.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_index stores state; pg_get_indexdef reconstructs the definition.
sqlText: SELECT indrelid::regclass AS table_name,indexrelid::regclass AS index_name,indisunique,indisprimary,indisvalid,indisready,pg_get_indexdef(indexrelid) AS definition FROM pg_index ORDER BY indrelid::regclass::text,indexrelid::regclass::text LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect index definitions.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect view definitions
overview: See how logical views are represented and recover their defining query.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_views lists views; definition contains normalized SQL.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,viewname,viewowner,definition FROM pg_views WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY schemaname,viewname LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect view definitions.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect functions and procedures
overview: Discover routines, languages, volatility, parallel safety, and overload signatures.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_proc stores routines; pg_get_function_identity_arguments renders signatures.
sqlText: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,p.proname,p.prokind,l.lanname AS language,p.provolatile,p.proparallel,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect functions and procedures.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect catalog dependencies
overview: See explicit object relationships used for safe DDL and cascading behavior.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_depend links objects; pg_describe_object renders their names.
sqlText: SELECT pg_describe_object(classid,objid,objsubid) AS dependent,deptype,pg_describe_object(refclassid,refobjid,refobjsubid) AS referenced FROM pg_depend WHERE refobjid='pg_catalog.pg_class'::regclass LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect catalog dependencies.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect installed extensions
overview: Identify extension-managed features and their schemas without installing anything.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_extension records installed extensions and versions.
sqlText: SELECT extname,extversion,extnamespace::regnamespace AS schema,extrelocatable FROM pg_extension ORDER BY extname;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect installed extensions.
systemsLens: Treat PostgreSQL metadata as a queryable control plane.

title: Inspect configuration settings
overview: Treat configuration as queryable data, including source, context, and restart needs.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_settings exposes effective values and provenance.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,context,source,pending_restart FROM pg_settings ORDER BY name LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect configuration settings.
systemsLens: Relate node policy and resource limits to system behavior.

title: Inspect memory settings
overview: Compare major per-operation and shared memory controls.
syntaxBreakdown: IN filters pg_settings to named parameters.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('shared_buffers','work_mem','maintenance_work_mem','effective_cache_size','temp_buffers','huge_pages') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect memory settings.
systemsLens: Relate node policy and resource limits to system behavior.

title: Inspect connection capacity
overview: Relate maximum connections and reserved slots to process and memory pressure.
syntaxBreakdown: IN filters connection-related settings.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('max_connections','superuser_reserved_connections','reserved_connections') ORDER BY name;
caution: reserved_connections is absent on older versions.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect connection capacity.
systemsLens: Relate node policy and resource limits to system behavior.

title: Trace configuration provenance
overview: Find the file and line supplying settings and any parse errors.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_file_settings exposes file precedence, applied status, and errors.
sqlText: SELECT sourcefile,sourceline,name,setting,applied,error FROM pg_file_settings ORDER BY sourcefile,sourceline;
expectedResult: Rows describing trace configuration provenance.
systemsLens: Relate node policy and resource limits to system behavior.

title: Find non-default effective settings
overview: Spot configuration choices differing from built-in defaults.
syntaxBreakdown: IS DISTINCT FROM safely compares effective and boot values.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,boot_val,reset_val,source FROM pg_settings WHERE setting IS DISTINCT FROM boot_val ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing find non-default effective settings.
systemsLens: Relate node policy and resource limits to system behavior.

title: Inspect transaction identity
overview: See whether this session has an XID and inspect its current snapshot.
syntaxBreakdown: txid_current_if_assigned() avoids allocating an XID; txid_current_snapshot() returns bounds.
sqlText: SELECT txid_current_if_assigned() AS assigned_xid, txid_current_snapshot() AS snapshot;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect transaction identity.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Decompose an MVCC snapshot
overview: Understand xmin, xmax, and in-progress XIDs defining row visibility.
syntaxBreakdown: Snapshot functions extract bounds and active XIDs.
sqlText: WITH s AS (SELECT txid_current_snapshot() AS snap) SELECT txid_snapshot_xmin(snap) AS xmin,txid_snapshot_xmax(snap) AS xmax,txid_snapshot_xip(snap) AS in_progress FROM s;
expectedResult: Rows describing decompose an mvcc snapshot.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Inspect backend transaction horizons
overview: Find XID and xmin horizons that can prevent cleanup.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_activity exposes backend_xid, backend_xmin, and transaction age.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,state,backend_xid,backend_xmin,xact_start,clock_timestamp()-xact_start AS xact_age,wait_event_type,wait_event FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_xid IS NOT NULL OR backend_xmin IS NOT NULL ORDER BY xact_start NULLS LAST;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect backend transaction horizons.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Read tuple MVCC metadata
overview: Observe xmin, xmax, and physical tuple location on a catalog.
syntaxBreakdown: xmin/xmax are transaction metadata; ctid is the current physical location.
sqlText: SELECT ctid,xmin,xmax,oid,relname FROM pg_catalog.pg_class ORDER BY oid LIMIT 20;
caution: System columns are diagnostics, not durable application identifiers.
expectedResult: Rows describing read tuple mvcc metadata.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Measure live and dead tuple estimates
overview: Find relations accumulating obsolete row versions.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_user_tables estimates tuples and records maintenance times.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,relname,n_live_tup,n_dead_tup,last_vacuum,last_autovacuum,last_analyze,last_autoanalyze FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC,relname LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing measure live and dead tuple estimates.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Inspect autovacuum policy
overview: Understand thresholds, scale factors, timing, and worker capacity.
syntaxBreakdown: LIKE selects every autovacuum-prefixed setting.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name LIKE 'autovacuum%' ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect autovacuum policy.
systemsLens: Protect bounded storage and transaction-ID health.

title: Find per-table autovacuum overrides
overview: Identify relations whose maintenance policy differs from cluster defaults.
syntaxBreakdown: reloptions stores table-local options; cardinality tests for entries.
sqlText: SELECT oid::regclass AS relation,reloptions FROM pg_class WHERE relkind IN ('r','m') AND cardinality(reloptions)>0 ORDER BY oid::regclass::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing find per-table autovacuum overrides.
systemsLens: Protect bounded storage and transaction-ID health.

title: Observe running vacuum work
overview: Track vacuum phase, heap scan, and index cleanup progress.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_progress_vacuum contains one row per active VACUUM.
sqlText: SELECT pid,datname,relid::regclass AS relation,phase,heap_blks_total,heap_blks_scanned,heap_blks_vacuumed,index_vacuum_count FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum ORDER BY pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing observe running vacuum work.
systemsLens: Protect bounded storage and transaction-ID health.

title: Inspect transaction ID freeze age
overview: Find databases and tables approaching wraparound thresholds.
syntaxBreakdown: age() measures XIDs elapsed since a frozen horizon.
sqlText: SELECT 'database' AS object_type,datname AS object_name,age(datfrozenxid) AS xid_age FROM pg_database UNION ALL SELECT 'table',oid::regclass::text,age(relfrozenxid) FROM pg_class WHERE relkind IN ('r','m') ORDER BY xid_age DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect transaction id freeze age.
systemsLens: Protect bounded storage and transaction-ID health.

title: Inspect multixact freeze age
overview: Monitor shared row-lock metadata horizons separately from XIDs.
syntaxBreakdown: mxid_age() compares frozen multixact horizons with the current counter.
sqlText: SELECT 'database' AS object_type,datname AS object_name,mxid_age(datminmxid) AS mxid_age FROM pg_database UNION ALL SELECT 'table',oid::regclass::text,mxid_age(relminmxid) FROM pg_class WHERE relkind IN ('r','m') ORDER BY mxid_age DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect multixact freeze age.
systemsLens: Protect bounded storage and transaction-ID health.

title: Measure HOT update effectiveness
overview: See when updates avoid creating new index entries.
syntaxBreakdown: n_tup_hot_upd counts HOT updates; NULLIF avoids division by zero.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,relname,n_tup_upd,n_tup_hot_upd,round(100.0*n_tup_hot_upd/NULLIF(n_tup_upd,0),2) AS hot_pct FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_tup_upd DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing measure hot update effectiveness.
systemsLens: Connect snapshot visibility to cleanup and concurrency costs.

title: Inspect fillfactor and storage options
overview: Find tables reserving page space to favor HOT updates.
syntaxBreakdown: reloptions contains explicit storage options; NULL means defaults.
sqlText: SELECT oid::regclass AS relation,relkind,reloptions FROM pg_class WHERE relkind IN ('r','m','i') AND relnamespace NOT IN ('pg_catalog'::regnamespace,'information_schema'::regnamespace) ORDER BY oid::regclass::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect fillfactor and storage options.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Inspect isolation and read-only defaults
overview: Establish transaction semantics used when applications do not override them.
syntaxBreakdown: current_setting() returns effective session values.
sqlText: SELECT current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,current_setting('transaction_deferrable') AS deferrable,current_setting('default_transaction_isolation') AS default_isolation;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect isolation and read-only defaults.
systemsLens: Reason about atomicity, snapshots, and retained resources.

title: Find long-running transactions
overview: Detect transactions retaining snapshots, locks, and old row versions.
syntaxBreakdown: xact_start marks transaction start; clock_timestamp() computes age.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,datname,state,clock_timestamp()-xact_start AS transaction_age,wait_event_type,wait_event,left(query,120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL ORDER BY xact_start;
expectedResult: Rows describing find long-running transactions.
systemsLens: Reason about atomicity, snapshots, and retained resources.

title: Find idle transactions
overview: Locate sessions doing no work while retaining transactional resources.
syntaxBreakdown: state filters idle transaction states; state_change measures idle duration.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,datname,state,clock_timestamp()-state_change AS idle_for,xact_start,left(query,120) AS last_query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state LIKE 'idle in transaction%' ORDER BY state_change;
expectedResult: Rows describing find idle transactions.
systemsLens: Reason about atomicity, snapshots, and retained resources.

title: Inspect prepared transactions
overview: See unresolved two-phase commits retained for a coordinator decision.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_prepared_xacts lists global IDs, owners, databases, and times.
sqlText: SELECT transaction,gid,prepared,owner,database FROM pg_prepared_xacts ORDER BY prepared;
caution: Prepared transactions can retain locks indefinitely after coordinator failure.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect prepared transactions.
systemsLens: Reason about atomicity, snapshots, and retained resources.

title: Inspect current locks
overview: See held and awaited locks by backend, object, mode, and scope.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_locks exposes lock-manager state; granted distinguishes holders and waiters.
sqlText: SELECT pid,locktype,relation::regclass AS relation,page,tuple,virtualxid,transactionid,mode,granted,fastpath FROM pg_locks ORDER BY granted,pid,locktype;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect current locks.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Find sessions waiting for locks
overview: Focus on blocked sessions and their requested modes.
syntaxBreakdown: NOT granted selects queued locks; pg_stat_activity adds query context.
sqlText: SELECT l.pid,a.usename,l.locktype,l.relation::regclass AS relation,l.mode,a.wait_event,left(a.query,120) AS query FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a USING(pid) WHERE NOT l.granted ORDER BY a.query_start;
expectedResult: Rows describing find sessions waiting for locks.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Map waiters to blockers
overview: Build dependency edges for lock contention diagnosis.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_blocking_pids returns blocker PIDs; LATERAL unnest expands them.
sqlText: SELECT a.pid AS waiting_pid,b.blocking_pid,clock_timestamp()-a.query_start AS wait_age,left(a.query,100) AS waiting_query FROM pg_stat_activity a CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(a.pid)) AS b(blocking_pid) ORDER BY wait_age DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing map waiters to blockers.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Show both sides of blocking
overview: Join waiters to blocker sessions so ownership and SQL are visible.
syntaxBreakdown: LATERAL expands blocker PIDs; a second activity join supplies blocker details.
sqlText: SELECT w.pid AS waiting_pid,w.usename AS waiting_user,b.pid AS blocking_pid,b.usename AS blocking_user,left(w.query,80) AS waiting_query,left(b.query,80) AS blocking_query FROM pg_stat_activity w CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(pg_blocking_pids(w.pid)) x(pid) JOIN pg_stat_activity b ON b.pid=x.pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing show both sides of blocking.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Summarize relation lock pressure
overview: Count lock holders and waiters by table and mode.
syntaxBreakdown: GROUP BY aggregates locks; FILTER counts ungranted locks.
sqlText: SELECT relation::regclass AS relation,mode,count(*) AS total,count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT granted) AS waiting FROM pg_locks WHERE relation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY relation,mode ORDER BY waiting DESC,total DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing summarize relation lock pressure.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Inspect serializable predicate locks
overview: Observe SIReadLock entries used by serializable snapshot isolation.
syntaxBreakdown: mode='SIReadLock' selects predicate locks.
sqlText: SELECT pid,locktype,relation::regclass AS relation,page,tuple,mode FROM pg_locks WHERE mode='SIReadLock' ORDER BY pid,relation,page,tuple;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect serializable predicate locks.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Inspect advisory locks
overview: See application-defined coordination locks managed by PostgreSQL.
syntaxBreakdown: locktype='advisory' isolates advisory locks; classid/objid encode keys.
sqlText: SELECT pid,classid,objid,objsubid,mode,granted FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' ORDER BY granted,pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect advisory locks.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Inspect timeout defenses
overview: Review bounds on lock waits, statements, idle transactions, and deadlock checks.
syntaxBreakdown: IN filters pg_settings to timeout parameters.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('lock_timeout','statement_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','deadlock_timeout') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect timeout defenses.
systemsLens: Model contention as a wait-for graph.

title: Summarize backend states
overview: Get a fast concurrency picture across active, idle, and transactional sessions.
syntaxBreakdown: GROUP BY backend type, state, and wait category counts sessions.
sqlText: SELECT backend_type,state,wait_event_type,count(*) AS sessions FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY backend_type,state,wait_event_type ORDER BY sessions DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing summarize backend states.
systemsLens: Relate session load to finite process and memory capacity.

title: Measure connection saturation
overview: Compare current client backends with the configured ceiling.
syntaxBreakdown: FILTER counts client backends; current_setting reads the limit.
sqlText: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE backend_type='client backend') AS client_connections,current_setting('max_connections')::int AS max_connections,round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE backend_type='client backend')/current_setting('max_connections')::int,2) AS used_pct FROM pg_stat_activity;
expectedResult: Rows describing measure connection saturation.
systemsLens: Relate session load to finite process and memory capacity.

title: Identify cancellable long queries
overview: Practice selecting exact backend targets without cancelling them.
syntaxBreakdown: state='active' selects running queries; pid exclusion protects this session.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,clock_timestamp()-query_start AS runtime,wait_event_type,wait_event,left(query,120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY query_start;
caution: This only identifies targets; cancellation is intentionally omitted.
expectedResult: Rows describing identify cancellable long queries.
systemsLens: Relate session load to finite process and memory capacity.

title: Inspect the current WAL position
overview: Read the current log sequence number and containing segment.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_current_wal_lsn returns an LSN; pg_walfile_name maps it to a segment.
sqlText: SELECT pg_current_wal_lsn() AS current_lsn,pg_walfile_name(pg_current_wal_lsn()) AS wal_segment;
caution: On standbys, receive and replay LSN functions are more meaningful.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect the current wal position.
systemsLens: Use the replicated log as the durability and ordering backbone.

title: Measure distance between LSNs
overview: Convert WAL positions into byte distance for lag and retention analysis.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_wal_lsn_diff returns bytes; pg_size_pretty formats them.
sqlText: SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),redo_lsn)) AS bytes_since_checkpoint_redo FROM pg_control_checkpoint();
expectedResult: Rows describing measure distance between lsns.
systemsLens: Use the replicated log as the durability and ordering backbone.

title: Inspect WAL durability settings
overview: Review WAL level, synchronous commit, full-page writes, and buffering.
syntaxBreakdown: IN filters pg_settings to durability parameters.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source,pending_restart FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('wal_level','synchronous_commit','fsync','full_page_writes','wal_compression','wal_buffers','wal_segment_size') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect wal durability settings.
systemsLens: Use the replicated log as the durability and ordering backbone.

title: Inspect WAL generation statistics
overview: Measure records, full-page images, bytes, buffer pressure, and write timing.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_wal contains cumulative counters since stats_reset.
sqlText: SELECT wal_records,wal_fpi,pg_size_pretty(wal_bytes::bigint) AS wal_bytes,wal_buffers_full,wal_write,wal_sync,wal_write_time,wal_sync_time,stats_reset FROM pg_stat_wal;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect wal generation statistics.
systemsLens: Use the replicated log as the durability and ordering backbone.

title: Inspect checkpoint control data
overview: Read checkpoint and redo positions from control metadata.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_control_checkpoint() returns checkpoint state without raw-file access.
sqlText: SELECT checkpoint_lsn,redo_lsn,redo_wal_file,timeline_id,prev_timeline_id,full_page_writes,next_xid,oldest_xid,checkpoint_time FROM pg_control_checkpoint();
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect checkpoint control data.
systemsLens: Connect dirty-page flushing to recovery time and I/O bursts.

title: Inspect checkpoint behavior
overview: See checkpoint frequency, timing, buffers written, and restartpoints.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_checkpointer exposes cumulative checkpoint-process counters.
sqlText: SELECT * FROM pg_stat_checkpointer;
caution: Before PostgreSQL 17, comparable counters are in pg_stat_bgwriter.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect checkpoint behavior.
systemsLens: Connect dirty-page flushing to recovery time and I/O bursts.

title: Inspect background writer activity
overview: Measure background cleaning and backend-write avoidance.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_bgwriter exposes cumulative buffer-cleaning counters.
sqlText: SELECT * FROM pg_stat_bgwriter;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect background writer activity.
systemsLens: Connect dirty-page flushing to recovery time and I/O bursts.

title: Inspect WAL retention policy
overview: Understand how checkpoints, archiving, and slots retain WAL space.
syntaxBreakdown: IN selects size and retention controls.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('min_wal_size','max_wal_size','wal_keep_size','max_slot_wal_keep_size','checkpoint_timeout','checkpoint_completion_target') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect wal retention policy.
systemsLens: Use the replicated log as the durability and ordering backbone.

title: Inspect WAL archiving health
overview: See archive successes, failures, last files, and recency.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_archiver contains cumulative archive-process counters.
sqlText: SELECT archived_count,last_archived_wal,last_archived_time,failed_count,last_failed_wal,last_failed_time,stats_reset FROM pg_stat_archiver;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect wal archiving health.
systemsLens: Reason about recoverability, replay, and RPO/RTO evidence.

title: Inspect archive configuration
overview: Verify whether archiving is enabled and how segments are handled.
syntaxBreakdown: IN selects archive mode, command, library, and timeout.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('archive_mode','archive_command','archive_library','archive_timeout') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect archive configuration.
systemsLens: Reason about recoverability, replay, and RPO/RTO evidence.

title: Determine primary or recovery state
overview: Establish whether this server generates or replays WAL.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_is_in_recovery identifies standby mode; receive/replay functions show progress.
sqlText: SELECT pg_is_in_recovery() AS is_in_recovery,pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() AS receive_lsn,pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() AS replay_lsn,pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS last_replay_time;
expectedResult: Rows describing determine primary or recovery state.
systemsLens: Reason about recoverability, replay, and RPO/RTO evidence.

title: Inspect backup and recovery configuration
overview: Review restore behavior, recovery targets, and upstream connectivity settings.
syntaxBreakdown: LIKE and IN select recovery-related settings.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name LIKE 'recovery_target%' OR name IN ('restore_command','primary_conninfo','primary_slot_name','hot_standby') ORDER BY name;
caution: Sensitive primary_conninfo fields may be masked.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect backup and recovery configuration.
systemsLens: Reason about recoverability, replay, and RPO/RTO evidence.

title: Inspect physical replication senders
overview: On a primary, see each sender's state, positions, sync mode, and client.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_replication has one row per WAL sender.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,application_name,client_addr,state,sent_lsn,write_lsn,flush_lsn,replay_lsn,sync_state,reply_time FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name,pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect physical replication senders.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Calculate replication byte lag
overview: Compare standby write, flush, and replay positions with the primary.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_wal_lsn_diff computes byte gaps from the current LSN.
sqlText: SELECT application_name,client_addr,pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),write_lsn)) AS write_gap,pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),flush_lsn)) AS flush_gap,pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),replay_lsn)) AS replay_gap FROM pg_stat_replication;
expectedResult: Rows describing calculate replication byte lag.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Inspect reported replication time lag
overview: Distinguish transport, durable-write, and replay delay estimates.
syntaxBreakdown: write_lag, flush_lag, and replay_lag are interval estimates.
sqlText: SELECT application_name,state,write_lag,flush_lag,replay_lag,sync_state FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect reported replication time lag.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Inspect the standby WAL receiver
overview: On a standby, see upstream state and receive progress.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_wal_receiver describes the receiver and is empty on primaries.
sqlText: SELECT pid,status,receive_start_lsn,written_lsn,flushed_lsn,received_tli,last_msg_send_time,last_msg_receipt_time,latest_end_lsn,latest_end_time,slot_name,sender_host,sender_port FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect the standby wal receiver.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Estimate standby replay delay
overview: Compare wall time with the last replayed transaction commit.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp returns the latest replayed commit time.
sqlText: SELECT now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS replay_delay,pg_last_wal_receive_lsn() AS receive_lsn,pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() AS replay_lsn;
caution: A quiet primary can make time delay look large without a WAL backlog.
expectedResult: Rows describing estimate standby replay delay.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Inspect replication slots
overview: See slot consumers, restart horizons, inactivity, and retained WAL risk.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_replication_slots lists physical and logical retention boundaries.
sqlText: SELECT slot_name,slot_type,database,active,active_pid,xmin,catalog_xmin,restart_lsn,confirmed_flush_lsn,wal_status,safe_wal_size,inactive_since FROM pg_replication_slots ORDER BY slot_name;
caution: inactive_since requires PostgreSQL 17; inactive slots can retain substantial WAL.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect replication slots.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Measure WAL retained by slots
overview: Quantify how much WAL each slot pins behind the current position.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_wal_lsn_diff compares current_lsn with restart_lsn.
sqlText: SELECT slot_name,slot_type,active,restart_lsn,pg_size_pretty(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),restart_lsn)) AS retained_wal FROM pg_replication_slots ORDER BY pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),restart_lsn) DESC NULLS LAST;
expectedResult: Rows describing measure wal retained by slots.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Inspect synchronous replication policy
overview: Understand commit quorum configuration and which senders satisfy it.
syntaxBreakdown: current_setting reads policy; pg_stat_replication reports sync_state.
sqlText: SELECT current_setting('synchronous_standby_names') AS policy,application_name,state,sync_state,sync_priority FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY sync_priority,application_name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect synchronous replication policy.
systemsLens: Measure distributed progress using WAL positions and lag.

title: Inspect replication origins
overview: See logical replication progress markers used for loop prevention and tracking.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_replication_origin_status reports remote and local LSN progress.
sqlText: SELECT external_id,remote_lsn,local_lsn FROM pg_replication_origin_status ORDER BY external_id;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect replication origins.
systemsLens: Understand row-level change streams and identity requirements.

title: Inspect logical publications
overview: See publication behavior and exposed tables.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_publication defines policy; pg_publication_tables expands relations.
sqlText: SELECT p.pubname,p.puballtables,p.pubinsert,p.pubupdate,p.pubdelete,p.pubtruncate,pt.schemaname,pt.tablename FROM pg_publication p LEFT JOIN pg_publication_tables pt ON pt.pubname=p.pubname ORDER BY p.pubname,pt.schemaname,pt.tablename;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect logical publications.
systemsLens: Understand row-level change streams and identity requirements.

title: Inspect logical subscription workers
overview: Observe apply workers, receive positions, and message timing.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_subscription reports worker state without connection credentials.
sqlText: SELECT subid,subname,worker_type,pid,leader_pid,relid::regclass AS relation,received_lsn,last_msg_send_time,last_msg_receipt_time,latest_end_lsn,latest_end_time FROM pg_stat_subscription ORDER BY subname,worker_type,relid;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect logical subscription workers.
systemsLens: Understand row-level change streams and identity requirements.

title: Inspect replica identity
overview: Find row identity available to logical replication for UPDATE and DELETE.
syntaxBreakdown: relreplident encodes identity mode; indisreplident identifies a selected index.
sqlText: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname,c.relreplident,i.indexrelid::regclass AS identity_index FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_index i ON i.indrelid=c.oid AND i.indisreplident WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect replica identity.
systemsLens: Understand row-level change streams and identity requirements.

title: Inventory partitioned tables
overview: See partition strategies, key counts, and reconstructed keys.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_partitioned_table stores strategy; pg_get_partkeydef renders the key.
sqlText: SELECT partrelid::regclass AS partitioned_table,partstrat,partnatts,pg_get_partkeydef(partrelid) AS partition_key FROM pg_partitioned_table ORDER BY partrelid::regclass::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing inventory partitioned tables.
systemsLens: Use data placement boundaries to control scale and pruning.

title: Walk partition hierarchies
overview: Expand parent-child trees with levels and leaf status.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_partition_tree is evaluated laterally for each root.
sqlText: SELECT p.partrelid::regclass AS root,t.relid::regclass AS relation,t.parentrelid::regclass AS parent,t.isleaf,t.level FROM pg_partitioned_table p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_partition_tree(p.partrelid) t ORDER BY root::text,t.level,relation::text LIMIT 200;
expectedResult: Rows describing walk partition hierarchies.
systemsLens: Use data placement boundaries to control scale and pruning.

title: Inspect partition bounds
overview: Read exact range, list, or hash bounds for partitions.
syntaxBreakdown: relpartbound stores an internal tree; pg_get_expr renders SQL.
sqlText: SELECT inhparent::regclass AS parent,inhrelid::regclass AS partition,pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound,c.oid,true) AS bound FROM pg_inherits i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.inhrelid WHERE c.relispartition ORDER BY parent::text,partition::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect partition bounds.
systemsLens: Use data placement boundaries to control scale and pruning.

title: Compare partition sizes
overview: Find skew and unexpectedly large leaves.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_partition_tree returns leaves; pg_total_relation_size includes related storage.
sqlText: SELECT p.partrelid::regclass AS root,t.relid::regclass AS leaf,pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(t.relid)) AS total_size,pg_total_relation_size(t.relid) AS bytes FROM pg_partitioned_table p CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_partition_tree(p.partrelid) t WHERE t.isleaf ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing compare partition sizes.
systemsLens: Use data placement boundaries to control scale and pruning.

title: Break down relation storage
overview: Compare heap, index, and total storage for user tables.
syntaxBreakdown: Size functions measure heap, indexes, TOAST, and totals.
sqlText: SELECT relid::regclass AS relation,pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) AS heap,pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(relid)) AS indexes,pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing break down relation storage.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Inspect relation forks
overview: Understand main data, free-space map, visibility map, and initialization forks.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_relation_size(relation,fork) measures each fork.
sqlText: SELECT c.oid::regclass AS relation,pg_relation_size(c.oid,'main') AS main_bytes,pg_relation_size(c.oid,'fsm') AS fsm_bytes,pg_relation_size(c.oid,'vm') AS vm_bytes,pg_relation_size(c.oid,'init') AS init_bytes FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY main_bytes DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect relation forks.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Inspect TOAST relationships
overview: Find oversized-value storage and connect it to owning relations.
syntaxBreakdown: reltoastrelid points to a TOAST relation; size functions measure it.
sqlText: SELECT c.oid::regclass AS relation,c.reltoastrelid::regclass AS toast_relation,pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.reltoastrelid)) AS toast_size FROM pg_class c WHERE c.reltoastrelid<>0 ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.reltoastrelid) DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect toast relationships.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Inspect tablespaces
overview: See logical storage placement and explicit relation allocation.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_tablespace defines locations; reltablespace links explicit users.
sqlText: SELECT t.spcname,pg_get_userbyid(t.spcowner) AS owner,pg_tablespace_location(t.oid) AS location,count(c.oid) AS explicit_relations FROM pg_tablespace t LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.reltablespace=t.oid GROUP BY t.oid,t.spcname,t.spcowner ORDER BY t.spcname;
caution: Tablespace locations may be hidden from non-privileged roles.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect tablespaces.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Inspect sequence metadata
overview: Understand type, bounds, increment, caching, and cycling.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_sequences provides normalized metadata for visible sequences.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,sequencename,data_type,start_value,min_value,max_value,increment_by,cycle,cache_size,last_value FROM pg_sequences ORDER BY schemaname,sequencename;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect sequence metadata.
systemsLens: Relate logical objects to physical footprint and locality.

title: Measure index usage
overview: Compare scans, tuple activity, and footprint for indexes.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_user_indexes supplies counters; pg_relation_size measures bytes.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,relname AS table_name,indexrelname AS index_name,idx_scan,idx_tup_read,idx_tup_fetch,pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(indexrelid)) AS size FROM pg_stat_user_indexes ORDER BY idx_scan ASC,pg_relation_size(indexrelid) DESC LIMIT 100;
caution: Low scan counts do not prove an index is unnecessary.
expectedResult: Rows describing measure index usage.
systemsLens: Balance read acceleration against write and storage amplification.

title: Find invalid or unfinished indexes
overview: Detect indexes unavailable for normal planning or maintenance.
syntaxBreakdown: indisvalid, indisready, and indislive encode index lifecycle state.
sqlText: SELECT indrelid::regclass AS table_name,indexrelid::regclass AS index_name,indisvalid,indisready,indislive FROM pg_index WHERE NOT indisvalid OR NOT indisready OR NOT indislive ORDER BY indrelid::regclass::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing find invalid or unfinished indexes.
systemsLens: Balance read acceleration against write and storage amplification.

title: Read a basic query plan
overview: See estimated access paths and costs without executing the query.
syntaxBreakdown: EXPLAIN invokes the planner; the SELECT remains unexecuted.
sqlText: EXPLAIN SELECT * FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid='pg_catalog.pg_attribute'::regclass;
expectedResult: Rows describing read a basic query plan.
systemsLens: Connect cost estimates to real resource consumption.

title: Compare estimates with execution
overview: Measure actual rows and buffers against planner estimates.
syntaxBreakdown: ANALYZE executes; BUFFERS reports cache I/O; TIMING OFF reduces overhead.
sqlText: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE,BUFFERS,TIMING OFF) SELECT * FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid='pg_catalog.pg_attribute'::regclass;
caution: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes its statement; keep it on SELECT while learning.
expectedResult: Rows describing compare estimates with execution.
systemsLens: Connect cost estimates to real resource consumption.

title: Inspect planner cost model
overview: Review assumptions pricing I/O, CPU, cache, and parallelism.
syntaxBreakdown: IN selects planner cost and parallel threshold parameters.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('seq_page_cost','random_page_cost','cpu_tuple_cost','cpu_index_tuple_cost','cpu_operator_cost','effective_cache_size','parallel_setup_cost','parallel_tuple_cost','min_parallel_table_scan_size','min_parallel_index_scan_size') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect planner cost model.
systemsLens: Connect cost estimates to real resource consumption.

title: Inspect planner column statistics
overview: See null fractions, distinct estimates, common values, histograms, and correlation.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stats presents ANALYZE results in readable form.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,tablename,attname,null_frac,n_distinct,most_common_vals,histogram_bounds,correlation FROM pg_stats WHERE schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY schemaname,tablename,attname LIMIT 100;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect planner column statistics.
systemsLens: Understand how sampled metadata shapes distributed workload cost.

title: Inspect statistics targets
overview: Find columns with custom sampling detail.
syntaxBreakdown: attstattarget=-1 means default; positive values request custom detail.
sqlText: SELECT attrelid::regclass AS relation,attname,attstattarget FROM pg_attribute WHERE attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped AND attstattarget<>-1 ORDER BY attstattarget DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect statistics targets.
systemsLens: Understand how sampled metadata shapes distributed workload cost.

title: Inspect multicolumn statistics
overview: Find dependency, distinct-count, and common-value statistics for correlated columns.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_statistic_ext defines objects; pg_get_statisticsobjdef reconstructs DDL.
sqlText: SELECT stxrelid::regclass AS relation,stxname,stxkeys,stxkind,pg_get_statisticsobjdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_statistic_ext ORDER BY stxrelid::regclass::text;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect multicolumn statistics.
systemsLens: Understand how sampled metadata shapes distributed workload cost.

title: Compare sequential and index access
overview: See which user tables use sequential versus index scans.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_user_tables exposes cumulative scan and tuple counters.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,relname,seq_scan,seq_tup_read,idx_scan,idx_tup_fetch FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY seq_tup_read DESC LIMIT 50;
expectedResult: Rows describing compare sequential and index access.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Estimate table cache hit ratios
overview: Compare logical block hits with PostgreSQL reads.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_statio_user_tables reports block activity; NULLIF avoids zero division.
sqlText: SELECT schemaname,relname,heap_blks_read,heap_blks_hit,round(100.0*heap_blks_hit/NULLIF(heap_blks_hit+heap_blks_read,0),2) AS heap_hit_pct FROM pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY heap_blks_read DESC LIMIT 50;
caution: OS cache hits still appear as PostgreSQL reads.
expectedResult: Rows describing estimate table cache hit ratios.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Inspect database I/O and temporary spill
overview: Find databases generating reads, temporary files, deadlocks, and checksum failures.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_database contains cumulative per-database counters.
sqlText: SELECT datname,blks_read,blks_hit,temp_files,pg_size_pretty(temp_bytes) AS temp_bytes,deadlocks,blk_read_time,blk_write_time,checksum_failures,stats_reset FROM pg_stat_database ORDER BY temp_bytes DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect database i/o and temporary spill.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Inspect parallel execution capacity
overview: Compare configured worker limits with active parallel workers.
syntaxBreakdown: current_setting reads limits; pg_stat_activity counts workers.
sqlText: SELECT current_setting('max_worker_processes') AS max_workers,current_setting('max_parallel_workers') AS max_parallel_workers,current_setting('max_parallel_workers_per_gather') AS per_gather,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type='parallel worker') AS active_parallel_workers;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect parallel execution capacity.
systemsLens: Connect cost estimates to real resource consumption.

title: Find long-running active queries
overview: Rank executing statements by runtime with wait context.
syntaxBreakdown: query_start supplies duration; state='active' excludes idle sessions.
sqlText: SELECT pid,usename,datname,clock_timestamp()-query_start AS runtime,wait_event_type,wait_event,left(query,160) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='active' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() ORDER BY query_start;
expectedResult: Rows describing find long-running active queries.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Summarize wait events
overview: See where active backends stall across locks, I/O, clients, and WAL.
syntaxBreakdown: Wait fields classify current waits; GROUP BY counts them.
sqlText: SELECT backend_type,wait_event_type,wait_event,count(*) AS sessions FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY backend_type,wait_event_type,wait_event ORDER BY sessions DESC;
expectedResult: Rows describing summarize wait events.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Discover active maintenance operations
overview: Combine progress views for vacuum, index build, analyze, and cluster.
syntaxBreakdown: UNION ALL normalizes operation, PID, relation, and phase.
sqlText: SELECT 'vacuum' AS operation,pid,relid::regclass AS relation,phase FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum UNION ALL SELECT 'create_index',pid,relid::regclass,phase FROM pg_stat_progress_create_index UNION ALL SELECT 'analyze',pid,relid::regclass,phase FROM pg_stat_progress_analyze UNION ALL SELECT 'cluster',pid,relid::regclass,phase FROM pg_stat_progress_cluster ORDER BY operation,pid;
expectedResult: Rows describing discover active maintenance operations.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Inspect diagnostic logging policy
overview: Review logging for statements, durations, locks, checkpoints, and connections.
syntaxBreakdown: IN selects diagnostic logging parameters.
sqlText: SELECT name,setting,unit,source FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('logging_collector','log_destination','log_min_duration_statement','log_statement','log_lock_waits','log_checkpoints','log_connections','log_disconnections','log_temp_files','log_line_prefix') ORDER BY name;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect diagnostic logging policy.
systemsLens: Turn cumulative counters and waits into operational signals.

title: Inspect checksum protection
overview: Determine whether page checksums are enabled and failures observed.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_control_system reports checksum version; database stats report failures.
sqlText: SELECT (SELECT data_checksum_version FROM pg_control_system()) AS checksum_version,sum(checksum_failures) AS observed_failures,max(checksum_last_failure) AS last_failure FROM pg_stat_database;
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect checksum protection.
systemsLens: Build evidence for failure detection and safe recovery.

title: Inspect recovery conflicts
overview: On standbys, see queries cancelled because replay needed resources.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_stat_database_conflicts contains cumulative conflict counters.
sqlText: SELECT datname,confl_tablespace,confl_lock,confl_snapshot,confl_bufferpin,confl_deadlock,confl_active_logicalslot FROM pg_stat_database_conflicts ORDER BY datname;
caution: confl_active_logicalslot requires PostgreSQL 16; values are normally zero on primaries.
expectedResult: Rows describing inspect recovery conflicts.
systemsLens: Build evidence for failure detection and safe recovery.

title: Audit role capabilities
overview: Inventory login, superuser, replication, bypass-RLS, and creation privileges.
syntaxBreakdown: pg_roles exposes role attributes while hiding password hashes.
sqlText: SELECT rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil FROM pg_roles ORDER BY rolname;
expectedResult: Rows describing audit role capabilities.
systemsLens: Build evidence for failure detection and safe recovery.

title: Build a systems health snapshot
overview: Combine uptime, recovery, connections, transaction age, size, WAL, and replica lag.
syntaxBreakdown: Scalar subqueries assemble independent health signals into one row.
sqlText: SELECT clock_timestamp() AS observed_at,current_database() AS database,pg_is_in_recovery() AS standby,clock_timestamp()-pg_postmaster_start_time() AS uptime,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type='client backend') AS connections,(SELECT max(clock_timestamp()-xact_start) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL) AS oldest_transaction,pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())) AS database_size,(SELECT pg_size_pretty(wal_bytes::bigint) FROM pg_stat_wal) AS wal_bytes_since_reset,(SELECT max(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(),replay_lsn)) FROM pg_stat_replication) AS worst_replica_byte_lag;
caution: Cumulative counters need reset times and historical baselines before becoming rates.
expectedResult: Rows describing build a systems health snapshot.
systemsLens: Build evidence for failure detection and safe recovery.
